node.statement: The split from node 1.3 has p_v=sum_{j in A} alpha_j^+ p_j +(1-sigma_a)q with coefficients alpha_j^+>=0 and s=sum_{j in A} alpha_j^+=sigma_a<1. For each j in A, node 1.1 gives dist_1(p_j,C)=d_j<=H=dist_1(p_v,C). Hence lem-residual-lower applies (with the empty-A case giving q=p_v directly) and yields H<=dist_1(q,C).
